title: ArcCivs 0.1.117 real tavern service and uninterrupted existing workplace
assumptions: Before source69cbe21/0.1.116; after0.1.117. This is source assessment; deployment and observed runtime acceptance are separate evidence.

No prices, recipe quantities, work durations, fallback probabilities, hunger clock or automatic food buffer are changed. Existing adults lose1 hunger per observed awake minute, children1 per2minutes; one existing bread restores6hunger.

The low/base/high retained assumptions are5adults per settlement,0.25/1/4awake hours/day and1/10/16towns. At existing50bread per town-hour this remains12.5/50/200bread consumed per town-day in both versions, excluding initial hunger phase and one-time shelf fill. These are assumptions, not measured sessions.

Tavern service is a native container-to-keeper-bag-to-guest-bag transfer. Both bag before-images and guest meal counter fence replay; observing a meal consumes existing food once. No service reward, native food mint or abstract stock debit is added.

The already existing Auto food support can replenish a genuine deficit. Existing local stocks, reachable items and accepted incoming cargo reduce it; ordinary settlements have no such automatic grant. Existing4bread per resident buffer and64maximum are unchanged.

Active old-level workplaces keep doing their existing work during an upgrade. Short pending storage/journal mutations suspend construction writes and resume the same paid batch. Unfinished new buildings do not gain work; no additional output per action, XP reward or tool use is added.

Well-fed observed awake residents at hunger18+ regain1HP per4seconds up to personal maximum, without resurrection or offline catchup. Hunger expenditure stays unchanged. HP is not player XP or a monetary unit; this can improve uptime without changing the production rate.

New tavern schematics retain ordinary exact material billing. The five-cell administrative repair of the existing test-world tavern is a one-time owner-authorized fixture change, not an economic reward or repeatable acquisition path.

Current EconomyShopGUI SELL/AutoSell and future SELL-to-contract transition remain separate flows. No item-to-Vault conversion or contract income is invented. Downstream sale value and measured throughput are not established by this assessment.
